name: Cheng De Lolo Company Limited
summary: Cheng De Lolo Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of plant protein beverages in China. The company offers wolfberry and mulberry drink, longan, ginger and jujube drink, tangerine peel and plum drink, loquat and autumn pear drink, sparkling water series products, such as hawthorn sparkling water and white peach sparkling water, and milk series products including almond milk and almond milk. It sells its products through online sales platforms. It also provides milk series, such as plain almond milk and almond milk series. The company was formerly known as He Bei Cheng De Lolo Company Limited and changed its name to Cheng De Lolo Company Limited…
